title: Exceptional integral scalar transport data and ambient evaluation
statement: Retain the actual coefficient stages, normalized strict systems, reconstruction equivalences, scalar mate records, transported adjunction, and reduction/system comparison records of lem-sf-exceptional-integral-scalar-mates. For a reconstruction R at E,T and positive level n+1, define its ambient evaluation isomorphism from the finite evaluation of R.equivalence.functor to ordinary finite derived tensor by composing R.evaluation_eq, R.reduction, and R.calculus.reductionEvaluation. Normalize ReductionMates.evaluation using this isomorphism, the inverse canonical PurCompactSupport.finiteReductionIso between the two recorded derived tensors, and the inverse scalar equality realization. The other data and signatures are unchanged.
